Intelligent Research Assistant
Project Report
3
System Architecture
The Intelligent Research Assistant follows a modern, decoupled client-server architecture,
relying entirely on RESTful APIs and asynchronous processing paradigms.
3.1
High-Level Overview
The system comprises the following core layers:
1. Presentation Layer (Frontend): Built using Vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
It utilizes Jinja2 templates served by the backend for rapid dynamic rendering.
2. Application Layer (Backend): A FastAPI application running on an ASGI
server (Uvicorn). It handles routing, authentication, business logic, file parsing,
and orchestration of the RAG pipeline.
3. Data Persistence Layer: MongoDB is used for storing metadata (Users, Workspaces,
Chat Sessions), while FAISS operates on the local filesystem for vector storage.
3.2
Backend Framework: FastAPI
FastAPI was selected over alternatives like Django or Flask due to its inherent asyn-
chronous nature and its utilization of standard Python type hints (pydantic). Docu-
ment processing and LLM generation are fundamentally I/O bound and computationally
heavy tasks. By using Python’s asyncio, the FastAPI backend can handle hundreds of
concurrent requests without blocking the main execution thread.
